out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Electric/pins-and-needles divine electricity; whole body numb; could not feel body borders; 'heart exploded' preceding OBE.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Jesus; Heavenly Father; Heavenly Mother (female element of God).
arrival.other_being_detail: Heavenly Mother; later observed a living friend in a temple and conveyed an answer 'similar to a guardian angel doing.'

environment.environment_other_detail: Overwhelmingly beautiful light perceived non-physically; later 'drift in the light.' No buildings/places shown; instead a 'tour' focused on the 'physics of heaven' and light permeating all things.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Instructed to learn from direct connection with Heavenly Father (not put others between), to stop fueling apocalyptic scenarios and focus attention on 'joyful transition'; instructed to share an answer with a friend praying in the temple (messenger/guardian-angel-like role). Also embraced a 'new assignment'/'phase two' after being told his process was '100% complete.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Felt like a heart attack; 'heart exploded' sensation during intense personal trials and surrender/meditative state; not described as medically confirmed.

person_demographics.religious_background_detail: States he was 'very Mormon' at the time (only exposed himself to church-sanctioned religious ideas).
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Very Mormon at time of experiences; later notes some content aligned more with New Age/Hindu consciousness concepts.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Multiple 'veil' crossings with escalating bliss; encounter/conversation with Jesus, Heavenly Father, Heavenly Mother; extensive teachings/downloads; veridical-like perception of a living friend in the temple and instructed message.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Energetic/vibrational buildup → fear/acceptance → 'heart exploded' → immediate arrival in overwhelming light → later approach of Jesus → veil crossing to Father → veil crossing to Mother → 'tour' focused on light/physics → shown living friend in temple → drifting in light → return while still feeling bliss connected to body.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Repeated 'explosions in my heart' and multiple crossings of 'another veil' into higher joy.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Conversation accompanied by parallel 'downloads' where understanding unfolded on many tangents simultaneously; future experienced as present.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Heavenly Mother encounter; 'physics of heaven' tour centered on light and manifestation/prayer; repeated heart 'explosions' as veil transitions; perception of living friend in temple with instructed message; explicit discussion of symbols across faith systems (Mormon symbols teaching New Age/Hindu-like consciousness ideas).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “As soon as I closed my eyes and let go, my heart exploded. I was free from the normal constraints of the body, and I immediately came forth into the most beautiful light I have ever seen.” / “It was like being connected to the internet of God where knowledge on every subject became instantaneously available.” / “There was no judgment whatsoever.” / “Would you like me to take you into the presence of Father? He would like to see you.” / “He told me my process was complete… ‘100% complete.’”
